steps.summary: (Optional) Clear all monsters here to unlock Lilly Roth's ALL-GEMS vendor shop in Town!
steps.layout_tell: Watch the remaining monster counter in the top-right corner until it hits 0.
steps.next_exit: Clear mobs (or skip) → Exit to Lioneye's Watch → Enter The Coast
steps.portal_tip: Only needed if your build requires buying off-class gems from Lilly Roth!

actions.text: Clear all monsters along the beach (Fallen from Grace)
Return to Lioneye's Watch → Exit East into The Coast

steps.gem_reward: Fallen from Grace (Lilly Roth): Unlocks all Skill & Support Gems for 1 Scroll of Wisdom/Transmutation!

variants.title: Beach Sweep
variants.desc: Clear down one side of the beach and back up the other.

steps.summary: Hug the coastline North-East → Tag Waypoint at the end → Enter The Mud Flats
steps.layout_tell: Same layout as Act 1: follow the water edge North-East straight to the Waypoint.
steps.next_exit: Tag WP → Enter The Mud Flats
steps.portal_tip: Watch out for Fire totems if your Fire Resistance dropped after Kitava!

actions.text: Run North-East along the beach shoreline
Tag Waypoint at the end & enter The Mud Flats

steps.boss_info: Karui Fire Totems: Cast Scorching Ray (degen lowers Fire Resist!).

steps.summary: Find & kill The Dishonoured Queen (usually NE/Center) for Eye of Conquest → Exit North-West to The Karui Fortress
steps.layout_tell: The Dishonoured Queen spawns in a Karui camp (usually NE); the locked gate to The Karui Fortress is along the NW cliff!
steps.next_exit: Loot Eye of Conquest → Open North-West Gate → Enter The Karui Fortress
steps.portal_tip: You MUST pick up the Eye of Conquest to open the Karui Fortress gate!

actions.text: Kill The Dishonoured Queen (NE/Center) & loot Eye of Conquest
Follow top cliff wall North-West into The Karui Fortress

steps.boss_info: The Dishonoured Queen: Summons Karui warriors & fire totems.

variants.title: NE Boss / NW Exit
variants.desc: Queen is right-of-center; Fortress gate is top-left.

steps.summary: Head North into Tukohama's Keep → Kill Tukohama (+1 Skill Pt!) → Exit North of arena into The Ridge
steps.layout_tell: Tukohama's Keep is in the center-north of the zone; the exit to The Ridge is at the top of his circular arena.
steps.next_exit: Kill Tukohama (+1 Pt) → Exit North into The Ridge
steps.portal_tip: Destroy the glowing Shield Totem when Tukohama becomes invulnerable!

actions.text: Enter Tukohama's Keep → Kill Tukohama, War's Herald (+1 Pt!)
Take the North exit out of Tukohama's arena into The Ridge

steps.boss_info: Tukohama, War's Herald: Scorching Ray rotating beams + heavy Fire slams.
steps.gem_reward: The Father of War (Tarkleigh): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

variants.title: Keep Pass-Through
variants.desc: Enter Keep from South, exit Keep from North.

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint near entrance → Follow outer ridge pathway to The Lower Prison entrance
steps.layout_tell: Pick left or right outer path and follow it to the opposite end where The Lower Prison gate sits.
steps.portal_tip: No required quests in The Ridge

actions.text: Tag Waypoint right inside entrance
Follow ridge path to The Lower Prison

variants.title: Oval Ridge
variants.desc: Exit is across from the entrance.

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint → Complete Cruel Lab Trial #1 → Find exit stairs to Shavronne's Tower
steps.layout_tell: Just like Act 1: hug outer perimeter walls from the Waypoint to find Cruel Trial #1 and the stairs to Shavronne's Tower.
steps.next_exit: Complete Cruel Trial #1 → Enter Shavronne's Tower
steps.portal_tip: Cruel Trial #1 can also be run later via The Lower Prison Waypoint!

actions.text: Tag Waypoint at entrance
(Now or Later) Complete Cruel Lab Trial #1 (Flame & Spike Traps)
Take stairs into Shavronne's Tower

variants.title: Outer Perimeter Grid
variants.desc: Trial and Tower stairs spawn in outer rooms.

steps.summary: Climb 3 prison/tower floors → Kill Shavronne & Reassembled Brutus on the roof → Exit to Prisoner's Gate
steps.layout_tell: Each floor's stairs are along the outer edge opposite where you entered.
steps.next_exit: Kill Shavronne & Brutus → Exit through Prison Rooftop to Prisoner's Gate
steps.portal_tip: Do not attack Shavronne while she has her thorny Lightning reflection aura up!

actions.text: Climb 3 floors of Shavronne's Tower to the Prison Rooftop
Kill Shavronne the Returned & Reassembled Brutus
Talk to Sin & walk out into Prisoner's Gate

steps.boss_info: Shavronne & Brutus: Lightning storms, floating levitation slam, and physical charges.

variants.title: 3-Floor Tower
variants.desc: Check opposite corners on each floor.

steps.compass: ROAD TO CLIFF (+1 PT ABBERATH) → WEST
steps.summary: Tag Waypoint → Follow road to cliff edge (Valley of the Fire Drinker) & Kill Abberath (+1 Pt!) → Exit West to Western Forest
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ ABBERATH TELL: Follow the cobblestone road straight to the dead-end cliff to enter Abberath's arena (+1 Skill Pt); the exit to Western Forest is off the road to the West!
steps.next_exit: Kill Abberath (+1 Skill Pt!) → Exit West into The Western Forest
steps.portal_tip: Never skip Abberath — he gives +1 Passive Skill Point + Pantheon!

actions.text: Tag Waypoint & follow cobblestone road to Valley of the Fire Drinker
Kill Abberath, the Cloven One (2 rooms) for +1 Passive Skill Point!
Exit arena & head West into The Western Forest

steps.boss_info: Abberath, the Cloven One: Heavy Fire Hoof-trail & Meteor Storm. Keep moving!
steps.gem_reward: The Cloven One (Bestel in Town): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

variants.title: Road to Abberath
variants.desc: Road leads to Abberath; Western Forest is on the non-road side.

steps.summary: Stay on the main cobblestone road through Western Forest into The Riverways → Tag Riverways WP!
steps.layout_tell: Do NOT leave the cobblestone road in Act 6 Western Forest — it leads 100% straight to The Riverways!
steps.next_exit: Follow road into The Riverways → Tag WP → Go North to The Wetlands
steps.portal_tip: Tag The Riverways Waypoint so you can come right back after killing Ryslatha in The Wetlands!

actions.text: Follow the cobblestone road NE through Western Forest into The Riverways
Tag The Riverways Waypoint along the road
From Riverways WP, head North (past 2 pillars) into The Wetlands

steps.gem_reward: Connects to The Wetlands (+1 Skill Point).

variants.title: 100% Road Path
variants.desc: Road connects Prisoner's Gate → Western Forest → Riverways WP.

steps.summary: Head North-West in The Wetlands → Enter The Spawning Ground → Kill Ryslatha (+1 Skill Pt!) → Logout to Riverways WP
steps.layout_tell: The Spawning Ground entrance is always along the North-West / West perimeter of The Wetlands.
steps.next_exit: Kill Ryslatha (+1 Skill Pt!) → Logout → Take WP to Riverways → Go SE to Southern Forest
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT after killing Ryslatha → Claim +1 Skill Point from Tarkleigh → WP to Riverways!

actions.text: Find The Spawning Ground (NW) → Kill Ryslatha, the Puppet Mistress (+1 Pt!)
Logout to Town → Claim +1 Pt from Tarkleigh → Take WP to The Riverways
From Riverways WP, follow road East/South-East into The Southern Forest

steps.boss_info: Ryslatha, the Puppet Mistress: Spawns exploding larvae eggs — crush the eggs by walking over them before they hatch!
steps.gem_reward: The Puppet Mistress (Tarkleigh): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

variants.title: NW Spawning Ground
variants.desc: Follow left/top wall to the tree cave.

steps.summary: Run through Southern Forest & Cavern of Anger → In The Beacon, escort 2 Fuel Carts → Sail to Brine King's Reef → Kill The Brine King
steps.layout_tell: In The Brine King's Reef: ALWAYS hug the LEFT (Counter-Clockwise) shoreline from the boat to reach the boss fastest!
steps.next_exit: Light Beacon → Sail to Reef → Hug LEFT wall → Kill The Brine King → Sail to Act 7
steps.portal_tip: Unlock Soul of the Brine King in your Pantheon (`Y` key) right after killing him for Stun Immunity!

actions.text: Tag Beacon WP → Stand in the 2 fuel circles to push them to the tower
Light Beacon & board Weylam's ship → In Reef, hug LEFT shoreline
Kill The Brine King → Take Weylam's boat to Act 7

steps.boss_info: The Brine King: Shrinking water ring with Lightning bolts & Cold waves. Stay inside the dry eye of the storm!
steps.gem_reward: Unlocks Major Pantheon: Soul of the Brine King & opens Act 7.

variants.title: Left-Hug Reef
variants.desc: Counter-clockwise shoreline is half the distance of clockwise.
